title: Rotating solid cylinder: centrifugal body force and plane-strain stresses (analytic)
description:
Quarter cross-section of a long solid steel rod (radius b = 10 mm, E 200 GPa, nu 0.3, density 7850 kg/m^3; void outside) spinning about its axis at omega: the centrifugal load is an x, y dependent body force f = rho omega^2 (x, y) (body_force feature, no inertia otherwise). Rollers on x_lo / y_lo are the symmetry lines, the rod surface is free. Plane strain (eps_zz = 0: a long rod whose ends are held, not the free-ended generalised plane strain). The sweep runs omega over 1000, 3000, 5000 rad/s (every stress ~ omega^2).
Analytic (Timoshenko, plane strain; A = rho omega^2 / (8 (1 - nu))): sigma_r = A (3 - 2 nu)(b^2 - r^2), sigma_theta = A ((3 - 2 nu) b^2 - (1 + 2 nu) r^2), sigma_zz = nu (sigma_r + sigma_theta), so in Cartesian form sigma_xx = A ((3 - 2 nu)(b^2 - x^2) - (1 + 2 nu) y^2), sigma_yy = A ((3 - 2 nu) b^2 - (1 + 2 nu) x^2 - (3 - 2 nu) y^2); u_r = (1 + nu)(1 - 2 nu) rho omega^2 r ((3 - 2 nu) b^2 - r^2) / (8 E (1 - nu)). Centre stress A (3 - 2 nu) b^2 = 8.4 MPa and rim displacement (1 + nu)(1 - 2 nu) rho omega^2 b^3 / (4 E) = 0.13 um at 5000 rad/s. Equilibrium: the x_lo roller reacts with F_x = -rho omega^2 b^3 / 3 per m of depth (the total x body force on the quarter).
The rod surface is a staircase of 128 cells per radius (its area and moment are off by a few 1e-4; the outermost cells scatter).
Derived values tab: sxx_centre / syy_centre / szz_centre (max over the rod, at the centre cell, ~1e-3), hoop_rim (probe in the rim cell on the x axis, sigma_theta(b) = A (2 - 4 nu) b^2, ~1-2 %), u_rim (probe u_x there, ~1e-3) and F_x_axis (x_lo reaction, ~1e-3).
Sweep tab: sxx_centre vs omega with the dashed omega^2 curve.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 5000 rad/s), half a cell above the x axis: sigma_r (solid.stress_xx), sigma_theta (solid.stress_yy), sigma_z (solid.stress_zz) and u_radial (solid.u_x); expected ~1 % of each curve's range.

parameters.name: rho_rod

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (128 cells per radius)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: side of the quarter model (rod plus a 4-cell void margin)

parameters.name: f_scale
parameters.description: centrifugal body force per m of radius, rho omega^2 in N/m^4

parameters.name: A_rot
parameters.description: plane-strain stress coefficient A in Pa/m^2

parameters.name: x_rim
parameters.description: rim probe x: centre of the last rod cell on the x axis

parameters.name: hoop_rim_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_yy at the rim probe in Pa (~A (2 - 4 nu) b^2)

parameters.name: u_rim_ref
parameters.description: analytic u_x at the rim probe in m
